draft.notice: Draft under review. This text describes what wordloop does with your data today and will be reviewed before the beta opens to the public.

sections.title: Who looks after your data
body: wordloop is an open source project, maintained by one person and non-commercial at this stage.
The contact for the person responsible for the data will be listed here before the beta opens: to be defined.

sections.title: What data we keep
body: Account: your e-mail and your name (from sign-up or, if you sign in with Google or GitHub, what they provide, and a profile picture if any).

Sign-in: the passkeys you registered (we keep only the public key, never your biometrics) and, if you create a password, only an irreversible code of it (never the password). We also keep where you signed in from: provider, device and session dates.
Preferences: language, theme and time zone, and the study goals you set.
Study: your cards, every answer you gave (with the time, how long it took and what you typed) and a summary of each study day.

sections.title: What we use it for
body: Only to make the app work: keep you signed in, build your study sessions, work out what to review and show your progress.
We do not sell your data, we do not show ads and we do not build profiles for third parties.

sections.title: What stays on your device
body: An essential session cookie, which scripts cannot read, so you stay signed in.
Your theme and language preferences, and the answers not yet sent when you study offline (they leave the device once sent).
We do not use advertising or usage-analytics cookies.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: Only with the services needed to run the app: the hosting of the server and the database; the e-mail service that sends sign-up and recovery links, when it is turned on; and Google and GitHub, only if you choose to sign in with them.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: For as long as your account exists. When you delete the account, everything is erased right away, including your answer history. Only an anonymous record that a deletion happened remains (the date and how many answers there were), with nothing that identifies you.
Backups: when they exist, they will be encrypted and replaced in short cycles. The exact period will be published here before the beta opens.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under Brazil LGPD, you can access your data, take it with you and ask for it to be erased. This is already in the app, under Settings, Your data: download a full copy as JSON and delete the account.
To delete, you type the account e-mail and must have signed in recently. There is no way back.
You can also complain to the Brazilian data protection authority (ANPD).

sections.title: Security
body: The app uses a secure connection (HTTPS), stores passwords only as an irreversible code, keeps the session in a protected cookie and asks for stronger confirmation to delete the account.
No system is perfect. If an incident affects your data, we will tell you.

sections.title: Changes to this text
body: This text may change as the app evolves. The update date is at the top, and important changes will be announced in the app.

sections.title: What wordloop is
body: An app to grow your English vocabulary with spaced repetition, made for Brazilian Portuguese speakers. It is in beta.

sections.title: Your account
body: You are responsible for keeping your passkey or password safe and your details correct. Use one account per person and an e-mail that is yours.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: Use the app to study. Do not try to access other people data, bypass security, overload the service or use it for anything illegal.

sections.title: Content and licenses
body: The wordloop code is free software under the MIT license. The study content (words, translations and examples) is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, and the images have their own licenses. Full credits are under Settings, Credits and licenses.

sections.title: Your data
body: How we look after your data is in the Privacy policy. You can download a copy and delete your account whenever you want.

sections.title: Beta and availability
body: During the beta, the service is provided as is, with no guarantee that it will always be available or error-free. Changes, outages and, in rare cases, loss of study data may happen.

sections.title: Ending
body: You can delete your account at any time. We may also suspend accounts that break these terms.

sections.title: Changes and governing law
body: These terms may change; important changes will be announced in the app. Brazilian law applies.
